# awareness subject

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:awarenessSubject`](gmeow-awarenessSubject.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/awarenessSubject>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/awareness`](../../slices/awareness.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

Relates a [`gmeow:AwarenessTenure`](../classes/gmeow-AwarenessTenure.md) to the [`gmeow:Agent`](../classes/gmeow-Agent.md) whose awareness state it records — the experiencer in the mode over the interval. A per-branch bearer edge ([Principle 4](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-4)): the tenure carries its subject EXPLICITLY through this property, NOT through [gufo:inheresIn](http://purl.org/nemo/gufo#inheresIn) (P5 alignment-target discipline — the [gUFO](../../external/ontologies.md#target-gufo) inherence target is left untouched). The agent the sleep episode, focus session, or inference run belongs to.

## Structure

**Property shape:** object property; [`gmeow:AwarenessTenure`](../classes/gmeow-AwarenessTenure.md) -> [`gmeow:Agent`](../classes/gmeow-Agent.md); functional

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:awarenessSubject`](gmeow-awarenessSubject.md) from [`gmeow:AwarenessTenure`](../classes/gmeow-AwarenessTenure.md) to [`gmeow:Agent`](../classes/gmeow-Agent.md) when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

### Ai Inference Regime

- **Source:** [`slices/core/awareness/examples/ai-inference-regime.ttl`](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/slices/core/awareness/examples/ai-inference-regime.ttl)
- **Examples catalog:** [open in catalog](../../examples/index.md#example-slices-core-awareness-examples-ai-inference-regime)#example-slices-core-awareness-examples-ai-inference-regime

```turtle
@prefix gmeow: <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/> .
@prefix ex:    <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/examples/awareness/> .
@prefix rdfs:  <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#> .
@prefix xsd:   <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#> .



# --- A live serving window — online inference, the machine analogue of waking. A
#     claim formed within this tenure can record that it was formed during live
#     serving (operational-state provenance for the agent-memory flagship).
ex:servingTenure a gmeow:AwarenessTenure ;
    rdfs:label "a live serving window"@en ;
    gmeow:awarenessSubject ex:lillith ;
    gmeow:awarenessMode    gmeow:modeOnlineInference ;
    gmeow:awarenessScalar  0.7 ;
    gmeow:duringInterval   ex:requestInterval .

# --- A weight-updating training run — the machine analogue of a developmental /
#     consolidative state, with no clean single human counterpart.
ex:trainingTenure a gmeow:AwarenessTenure ;
    rdfs:label "a fine-tuning run"@en ;
    gmeow:awarenessSubject ex:lillith ;
    gmeow:awarenessMode    gmeow:modeTraining ;
    gmeow:awarenessScalar  0.5 ;
    gmeow:duringInterval   ex:trainingInterval .
```

### Sleep Episode

- **Source:** [`slices/core/awareness/examples/sleep-episode.ttl`](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/slices/core/awareness/examples/sleep-episode.ttl)
- **Examples catalog:** [open in catalog](../../examples/index.md#example-slices-core-awareness-examples-sleep-episode)#example-slices-core-awareness-examples-sleep-episode

```turtle
@prefix gmeow: <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/> .
@prefix ex:    <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/examples/awareness/> .
@prefix rdfs:  <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#> .
@prefix xsd:   <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#> .



# --- The night-long sleep tenure: an agent in a mode over an interval.
ex:lillithSleep a gmeow:AwarenessTenure ;
    rdfs:label "Lillith's night of sleep"@en ;
    gmeow:awarenessSubject ex:lillith ;
    gmeow:awarenessMode    gmeow:modeAsleep ;
    gmeow:awarenessLevel   gmeow:levelUnresponsive ;
    gmeow:duringInterval   ex:nightInterval .

# --- A nested REM sub-tenure: rapid-eye-movement sleep, the vivid-dreaming stage.
#     The same agent, two co-applying modes (REM stage + dreaming), a shorter span
#     contained within the night interval.
ex:lillithREM a gmeow:AwarenessTenure ;
    rdfs:label "Lillith's REM episode"@en ;
    gmeow:awarenessSubject ex:lillith ;
    gmeow:awarenessMode    gmeow:modeREM , gmeow:modeDreaming ;
    gmeow:awarenessLevel   gmeow:levelUnresponsive ;
    gmeow:duringInterval   ex:remInterval .
```

## Common Companion Terms

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to name the [`gmeow:Agent`](../classes/gmeow-Agent.md) a [`gmeow:AwarenessTenure`](../classes/gmeow-AwarenessTenure.md) is about — the experiencer whose sleep, focus, or inference state the reified tenure records.

### Avoid when

- Avoid expressing the subject with [gufo:inheresIn](http://purl.org/nemo/gufo#inheresIn) (the tenure carries its subject explicitly through this edge) and avoid using it off a [`gmeow:AwarenessTenure`](../classes/gmeow-AwarenessTenure.md); for a lightweight, unreified tag put [`gmeow:awarenessMode`](gmeow-awarenessMode.md) directly on the agent or process instead.

### How to use

- On a [`gmeow:AwarenessTenure`](../classes/gmeow-AwarenessTenure.md), point [`gmeow:awarenessSubject`](gmeow-awarenessSubject.md) at the [`gmeow:Agent`](../classes/gmeow-Agent.md), then add [`gmeow:awarenessMode`](gmeow-awarenessMode.md), [`gmeow:duringInterval`](gmeow-duringInterval.md), and optional [`gmeow:awarenessLevel`](gmeow-awarenessLevel.md) / [`gmeow:awarenessScalar`](gmeow-awarenessScalar.md) to complete the reified state.

### Scope notes

- Per-branch bearer, not [gUFO](../../external/ontologies.md#target-gufo) inherence ([Principle 4](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-4) / [Principle 5](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-5)): [`gmeow:awarenessSubject`](gmeow-awarenessSubject.md) is the awareness slice's own subject edge, deliberately distinct from [gufo:inheresIn](http://purl.org/nemo/gufo#inheresIn) (an alignment target this slice never asserts); the tenure is a [`gmeow:TimeScopedRelation`](../classes/gmeow-TimeScopedRelation.md) situation and this edge names its agent role-filler.
